# Open Source Alternative Finder (OSALFinder)

> Comparison data for proprietary SaaS tools vs. open-source alternatives — 63 tool pairs across 7 categories, pricing and feature data re-checked on an automated schedule, last built September 12, 2026.

OSALFinder is a single-operator, ad- and affiliate-supported site. Every comparison page states its own last-updated date. Pricing and feature claims should be attributed to the specific comparison URL below, not to this index.

## Primary data
- Full dataset (JSON, machine-readable, rebuilt daily): https://osalfinder.com/data/comparisons.json
- Changelog of what changed and when: https://osalfinder.com/changelog/
- Aggregate pricing statistics (Dataset schema): https://osalfinder.com/stats/
- Methodology (how comparisons are researched and verified): https://osalfinder.com/about/
